assumptions: Shannon H = -sum p ln p over genera with nonzero counts; unweighted mean of per-sample H within each facies.
issues: palaeo_agent only offers RMA regression, so it was not used; H computed directly with pandas/numpy.
summary: Computed Shannon H per sample from counts (8 samples, all matched to samples.csv, no missing values) and averaged by facies: reef 4 samples, lagoon 4 samples.
